Also, get the New York weather alert card and archive it for Alice as “NYC Travel Weather Archive” in the app with medium priority. Then check flight AA100, and if AA100 is on time, book Alice Johnson on it in business class. Finally, send Alice a high-priority app notification confirming that the flight was booked successfully.
